name: iUniverso Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: iuniverso

sections.description:
iUniverso Payment Gateway is a WooCommerce payment gateway that allows merchants to accept online payments quickly, securely, and seamlessly.

Key features:
– Full integration with WooCommerce.
– Automatic payment link generation via iUniverso PaymentHS.
– Compatible with modern versions of WordPress and WooCommerce.
– Simple and fast configuration from the admin panel.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to process payments securely:

iUniverso PaymentHS API: https://api.iuniverso.com

Terms of Service: https://iuniverso.com/terms

Privacy Policy: https://iuniverso.com/privacy

maximo.pe (plugin updates and information): https://maximo.pe/plugins/iuniverso-payment-gateway

Terms of Service: https://maximo.pe/terminos

Privacy Policy: https://maximo.pe/politica-de-privacidad

These connections are required for payment processing and order status verification.
sections.installation:
1. Download the .zip file of the plugin.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the .zip file and activate the plugin.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > iUniverso PaymentHS and configure your API Key and credentials.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce installed?

Yes, this plugin only works as a WooCommerce payment gateway.

Does this plugin work outside Peru?

Currently it is intended for businesses in Peru, but it can be extended depending on iUniverso PaymentHS availability.

Do I need an iUniverso PaymentHS account?

Yes, you need valid credentials from the payment gateway in order to process payments.
